name: North Brunswick Foreign & Domestic Auto Repairs
what_they_do: Independent repair shop working on both domestic and imported cars, operating out of the bp station at 590 Georges Rd. Reviews describe brake, tire and general repair work with an emphasis on fair pricing.
customers: Local car owners and families in North Brunswick (inference from review content and the Georges Rd location)

size_signals.signal: Single shop located inside a bp fuel station

website_review.trust_signals: None owned; Google reviews emphasise honesty and fair pricing
website_review.out_of_date_signs: No website; profile asks for a website link ('Add website')
website_review.search_basics: No site to rank; the shop only appears through Google and directory scrapes
top_issues: No written services, prices or service area anywhere owned
No online quote or appointment path

agent_readiness.notes: Google profile has category, address, phone and hours ('Closed - Opens 9 AM') but no website link and no owner photos. Everything an agent could learn comes from third-party directory text; no schema, no first-party service or price text.

operations_signals.signal: Phone-only intake; no form or booking link on any owned property
Review theme is 'fair pricing' and 'honest staff', suggesting many price-shopping phone calls (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: One-page site (or GBP service list) naming the repairs they do, hours, makes covered and a quote-request form
top_opportunities.evidence: No website; Google profile shows 'Add website' as missing information

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automate quote intake: web form plus text-back so price questions do not tie up the counter phone
top_opportunities.evidence: No online quote path exists; reviews repeatedly centre on pricing questions

top_opportunities.opportunity: Systematic review requests to push past the current 47 reviews and offset the one damaging review
top_opportunities.evidence: Google review set includes a serious negative review about post-repair damage per Birdeye summary

scores.reasons: Gap: no web presence at all beyond a bare profile. Ability: 47 steady reviews and a busy Georges Rd corner suggest a viable small shop. Ease: one-pager plus review flow is days of work. Evidence: place page and two review aggregators read directly.
